_comment: Accepted production-dependency advisories. Every entry needs a reason and an expiry (YYYY-MM-DD); an expired entry fails tools/dependency-audit-check.mjs. Prefer fixing or overriding in package.json pnpm.overrides.

accepted.reason: Reached only through the Prisma CLI config loader (@prisma/config), which merges our own committed prisma config at build/migrate time, never request data. Fix needs deepmerge-ts 8, a major bump inside Prisma's own dependency tree.
